description: Selected Daily Star NTC pages S001–S003 returned tool-level 'URL not accessible' messages, not an HTTP status; bdnews24 Chinmoy search lead S012 returned an internal error with no article body. These are technical retrieval outcomes, not source-side denial evidence.
required_followup: Continue using other permitted sources for corroboration. Do not represent these as paywall/denial, and do not treat failed body access as a negative search.

description: The exact Daily Star URL for the 11,000+ NTC tea-worker strike returned HTTP 403 Forbidden during the body attempt. A post-observation fresh receipt records the source card as blocked_without_denial_evidence because historical denial evidence is absent; actual raw tool 403 is separately preserved in S005 notes.
required_followup: Do not request this body's content again. Use the manual-review/403 chronology and other sources; the search result's labor count is not a specific public-gathering count.

description: The 5 Nov Sylhet human-chain involved NTC workers from three state-owned gardens and explicitly appealed to government, but no count is reported. A 17,000 worker estimate refers to the entire NTC workforce, not this specific gathering.
required_followup: Find an event-specific simultaneous attendance estimate and verify whether further NTC demonstrations continued into later weeks/months.

description: Adviser appointments drew distinct student protests in Dhaka on 11 Nov and Rangpur on 12–13 Nov. The latter two days have same movement, demands, consecutive timing and >100 participants, but may be one continuing episode or two actions; link to Dhaka campus event is unproven.
required_followup: Review organizer identity, campaign continuity, precise locations/end times, and event-unit rules before final assignment.

description: On 25–26 Nov, Chinmoy Krishna Das supporters held a 60–70-person Shahbagh protest, a thousands-strong Chattogram court gathering, and separate demonstrations in multiple districts. Shared detention/release demand and organization suggest a campaign; local events and possible nationwide unit structure need review.
required_followup: Review national/local organization and episode boundaries; do not combine distinct towns or infer local headcounts from other sites.

description: The 26 Nov Dhaka Tribune national-roundup reports Jahangirnagar, Khulna and Barisal release protests without local attendance counts, while Feni has over 500. The word 'mass rally' alone is insufficient to establish threshold.
required_followup: Find local attendance evidence for each site; keep each under threshold pending until supported.

description: November discovery used English and Bangla web queries on protests, labor, adviser appointments and Chinmoy-related events. Search engines, source-access limitations, missing historical originals and limited time mean this dossier is not exhaustive or an official finding.
required_followup: Coordinator/reviewer may identify unsearched dates, sectors, languages or prior-event links. Structural validation must not be treated as coverage certification.

description: V1 effective copy fixes one invalid labor-demand enum to labor_wage_dispute and supplies missing end_precision values from the already-recorded end_date (day where date present; unknown where null). Original files remain untouched.
required_followup: Reviewer should confirm end-date precision is supported by each cited record; unknown/null preserved when no date existed.
